title: Orbit Intertwining Proposition for the Main Theorem
body_html:
Orbit Intertwining Proposition for the Main Theorem

Let \(\Sigma'=\#_{V,T'}(\Sigma)\), and let \(w\in V\otimes_D V'\) be the element produced by the construction of the target datum. In the generalized lattice model \(S(B_0)\), let \[ \Omega=K_M\cdot w+B_0 \] be the relevant \(K\times K'\)-orbit of the lattice coset, and let \(\eta_M\) be the product of the source and target \(K\)-types with the prescribed contragredient on the target side.

Then \[ \dim \operatorname{Hom}_{K_M}(\eta_M,S(B_0)_\Omega)=1. \] The proposition is proved by induction over the block decomposition of \(\Sigma\). It is the representation-theoretic bridge from the data-level construction to the nonzero theta lift in the main theorem.
proof_html:
The proof is by induction on the number of positive-depth blocks. In the one-block case, supercuspidal_theta.one_block_orbit_k_type_proposition computes the same Hom space directly. The stabilizer of the relevant orbit is written in terms of the \(\Delta^i\)-layers and the depth-\(s\) Moy-Prasad subgroup. The key oscillator character identity supercuspidal_theta.key_oscillator_character_identity compares the oscillator phase with the source and target characters, and the determinant character contribution is shown to be trivial. The remaining finite-field factor is exactly the depth-zero theta occurrence, so the Hom space has dimension one.

For the induction step, split off the highest-depth block using supercuspidal_theta.block_induction_setup and decompose the oscillator residual space using supercuspidal_theta.theta_block_decomposition_setup. The off-diagonal kappa-oscillator identification supercuspidal_theta.off_diagonal_kappa_oscillator_identification identifies the off-diagonal oscillator factor with the off-diagonal Yu \(\kappa\)-factor, and the block oscillator action factorization supercuspidal_theta.block_oscillator_action_factorization factors the oscillator representation into the top-block, lower-block, and off-diagonal factors.

Under this factorization the stabilizer representation also decomposes. Frobenius reciprocity reduces the desired Hom space to the tensor product of the Hom space for the top block and the Hom space for the remaining blocks. The first factor has dimension one by supercuspidal_theta.one_block_orbit_k_type_proposition, and the second has dimension one by the induction hypothesis. Therefore the original Hom space has dimension one.
